newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguayan ministers resign in party split.
newsitem.headline: Paraguayan ministers resign in party split.

text.p: Two Paraguayan cabinet ministers resigned on Tuesday in a dispute between rival factions of the governing Colorado Party over who will run as presidential candidate in 1998 elections.
Interior Minister Juan Morales said he and Integration Minister Juan Villamayor quit after talks that failed to agree on a candidate.
President Juan Wasmosy supports the candidacy of Finance Secretary Carlos Facetti, who said he will resign within a month to dedicate himself to campaigning full time.
But Morales said he and other ministers were backing Colorado Party president Luis Argana to be candidate.
"It seems to me that (Wasmosy) made a mistake, and I cannot stay on," Morales told a news conference.
Local radio reported that the ministers of Justice, Labour and Education would also step down to back Argana.
